using RecipeCommunity.Models;

namespace RecipeCommunity.Services;

public class RecipeService
{
    private readonly List<Recipe> _recipes;
    private int _nextId;

    public RecipeService()
    {
        _recipes = new List<Recipe>
        {
            new() { Id = 1, Title = "Classic Margherita Pizza", Category = "Italian",
                Ingredients = "Pizza dough
San Marzano tomatoes
Fresh mozzarella
Fresh basil
Olive oil
Salt",
                Steps = "1. Preheat oven to 475°F (245°C).
2. Roll out dough on a floured surface.
3. Spread crushed tomatoes evenly.
4. Tear mozzarella and distribute over sauce.
5. Bake for 10-12 minutes until crust is golden.
6. Top with fresh basil and a drizzle of olive oil.",
                TotalStars = 14, RatingCount = 3 },
            new() { Id = 2, Title = "Spaghetti Carbonara", Category = "Italian",
                Ingredients = "Spaghetti
Guanciale (or pancetta)
Egg yolks
Pecorino Romano
Black pepper",
                Steps = "1. Cook spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente.
2. Crisp guanciale in a pan over medium heat.
3. Whisk egg yolks with grated Pecorino and pepper.
4. Toss hot pasta with guanciale, remove from heat.
5. Stir in egg mixture quickly, tossing to coat without scrambling.",
                TotalStars = 10, RatingCount = 2 },
            new() { Id = 3, Title = "Chicken Tikka Masala", Category = "Indian",
                Ingredients = "Chicken thighs
Yogurt
Garam masala
Turmeric
Cumin
Crushed tomatoes
Heavy cream
Onion
Garlic
Ginger",
                Steps = "1. Marinate chicken in yogurt and spices for at least 1 hour.
2. Grill or broil chicken until charred.
3. Sauté onion, garlic, and ginger in a pan.
4. Add crushed tomatoes and simmer 15 minutes.
5. Stir in cream, add chicken, simmer 10 more minutes.
6. Serve over basmati rice.",
                TotalStars = 5, RatingCount = 1 },
            new() { Id = 4, Title = "Vegetable Pad Thai", Category = "Asian",
                Ingredients = "Rice noodles
Tofu
Bean sprouts
Green onions
Peanuts
Lime
Fish sauce
Tamarind paste
Brown sugar
Garlic",
                Steps = "1. Soak rice noodles in warm water for 20 minutes.
2. Press and cube tofu, fry until golden.
3. Mix tamarind paste, fish sauce, and brown sugar for sauce.
4. Stir-fry garlic, add noodles and sauce.
5. Toss with bean sprouts and green onions.
6. Serve with crushed peanuts and lime wedges.",
                TotalStars = 8, RatingCount = 2 },
            new() { Id = 5, Title = "Beef Tacos", Category = "Mexican",
                Ingredients = "Ground beef
Taco seasoning
Corn tortillas
Lettuce
Tomato
Cheddar cheese
Sour cream
Salsa",
                Steps = "1. Brown ground beef in a skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Add taco seasoning and water, simmer until thickened.
3. Warm tortillas in a dry pan or microwave.
4. Fill tortillas with seasoned beef.
5. Top with lettuce, tomato, cheese, sour cream, and salsa.",
                TotalStars = 12, RatingCount = 3 },
            new() { Id = 6, Title = "Guacamole", Category = "Mexican",
                Ingredients = "Avocados
Lime juice
Red onion
Cilantro
Jalapeño
Tomato
Salt",
                Steps = "1. Halve and pit avocados, scoop into a bowl.
2. Mash with a fork to desired consistency.
3. Stir in diced onion, tomato, jalapeño, and cilantro.
4. Add lime juice and salt to taste.
5. Serve immediately with tortilla chips.",
                TotalStars = 9, RatingCount = 2 },
            new() { Id = 7, Title = "Chocolate Chip Cookies", Category = "Desserts",
                Ingredients = "Butter
Sugar
Brown sugar
Eggs
Vanilla extract
All-purpose flour
Baking soda
Salt
Chocolate chips",
                Steps = "1. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
2. Cream butter with both sugars until fluffy.
3. Beat in eggs and vanilla.
4. Mix in flour, baking soda, and salt.
5. Fold in chocolate chips.
6. Drop spoonfuls onto baking sheets.
7. Bake 9-11 minutes until edges are golden.",
                TotalStars = 15, RatingCount = 3 },
            new() { Id = 8, Title = "Miso Soup", Category = "Asian",
                Ingredients = "Dashi stock
White miso paste
Silken tofu
Wakame seaweed
Green onions",
                Steps = "1. Bring dashi stock to a gentle simmer.
2. Rehydrate wakame in water, drain.
3. Cube silken tofu.
4. Remove pot from heat, whisk in miso paste.
5. Add tofu and wakame.
6. Garnish with sliced green onions.",
                TotalStars = 4, RatingCount = 1 },
        };
        _nextId = 9;
    }

    public IReadOnlyList<string> GetCategories()
    {
        return _recipes.Select(r => r.Category).Distinct().OrderBy(c => c).ToList();
    }

    public IReadOnlyList<Recipe> GetByCategory(string category)
    {
        return _recipes.Where(r => r.Category.Equals(category, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)).ToList();
    }

    public Recipe? GetById(int id)
    {
        return _recipes.FirstOrDefault(r => r.Id == id);
    }

    public void AddRating(int recipeId, int stars)
    {
        var recipe = GetById(recipeId);
        if (recipe is not null && stars is >= 1 and <= 5)
        {
            recipe.TotalStars += stars;
            recipe.RatingCount++;
        }
    }

    public Recipe AddRecipe(string title, string category, string ingredients, string steps)
    {
        var recipe = new Recipe
        {
            Id = _nextId++,
            Title = title,
            Category = category,
            Ingredients = ingredients,
            Steps = steps
        };
        _recipes.Add(recipe);
        return recipe;
    }
}

data.content:
The project builds cleanly. Here's what was created:

**Project structure:**
- `Models/Recipe.cs` — recipe model with rating support
- `Services/RecipeService.cs` — singleton service with 8 seed recipes across 5 categories
- **Pages:**
  - `Home.razor` — homepage with category cards (static SSR)
  - `Category.razor` — browse recipes by category (static SSR)
  - `RecipeDetail.razor` — full recipe view with ingredients & steps (static SSR)
  - `SubmitRecipe.razor` — interactive form with `@rendermode InteractiveServer`
  - `StarRating.razor` — interactive 1–5 star widget with hover/click, applied per-component via `@rendermode`

**Render mode strategy:** Most pages render as static SSR. Only the star rating widget and submit form use `InteractiveServer`, matching the requirement that read-only pages stay static while only interactive elements use SignalR.

Run with `dotnet run --project RecipeCommunity` to start the app.
